# Culprit SQL

> Free, open-source (MIT) database root-cause and fleet reliability platform for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, YugabyteDB, MySQL, MariaDB, and SQLite. One shared Rust diagnosis and execution-plan engine powers a 14 MB native desktop app (`Culprit SQL Studio`), a JSON/SARIF CLI (`culprit`), a 27-tool local and remote MCP server, a bounded 24/7 Kubernetes collector (`culprit collect`) writing to Azure Data Explorer or ClickHouse, a zero-driver fleet web UI (`Culprit Fleet`), a client-side WebAssembly plan/deadlock/`.xel` analyzer (`Culprit Explain`), and shift-left CI/IDE/test guardrails.

Key facts:

- **Deterministic evidence-gated checks (`__CHECK_COUNT__` checks)**: slow queries ranked by share of database time, plan regressions, missing/unused/duplicate indexes, parameter-sensitive plans, blocking chains, deadlocks, lock escalations, subtransaction/MultiXact SLRU pressure, sequence/XID exhaustion, spills, cloud posture, and table-locking SQL migrations.
- **Strict safety & isolation**: scans query catalog and statistics views only with short lock timeouts; `Culprit Fleet` compiles zero SQL database drivers into its web tier; `Culprit Explain` runs 100% client-side in WebAssembly; `@culpritsql/ci` lints migrations offline against saved schema snapshots.
- **Coding agents (`culprit mcp`)**: 27 tools for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any MCP client, governed by per-connection policies, statement-by-statement read-only rollback approvals, and `culprit audit`.
- **9 localized languages**: English (`/`), Simplified Chinese (`/zh/`), Japanese (`/ja/`), Korean (`/ko/`), Russian (`/ru/`), German (`/de/`), Spanish (`/es/`), French (`/fr/`), and Portuguese (`/pt/`).

## Platform Surfaces

- [Culprit SQL Home](https://culpritsql.com/): architecture overview, surface switcher, governance specs, and supported engines
- [Studio, CLI & Local MCP](https://culpritsql.com/studio/): 14 MB macOS/Windows/Linux desktop app, CLI, and 27-tool MCP server
- [Fleet & Bounded Collector](https://culpritsql.com/fleet/): self-hosted 24/7 fleet triage on Azure Data Explorer or ClickHouse (`https://fleet.culpritsql.com/`)
- [Explain & WebAssembly SDKs](https://culpritsql.com/explain/): client-side `.sqlplan`, `.xel` Extended Events, `EXPLAIN`, and deadlock analyzer (`https://explain.culpritsql.com/`)
- [CI, VS Code & Developer Guardrails](https://culpritsql.com/ci/): `@culpritsql/ci` SARIF PR gates, `Culprit SQL for VS Code`, `@culpritsql/test`, and `@culpritsql/devtools`
- [Enterprise Security & Governance](https://culpritsql.com/enterprise/): trust boundaries, identity/keychain/OIDC, air-gapped deployment, and MIT licensing
- [Release Notes & Changelog](https://culpritsql.com/releases/): synced GitHub Releases across Studio, Collector, VS Code, CI, and Wasm packages ([RSS](https://culpritsql.com/releases/rss.xml))

## Supported Databases

- [Engine Parity Matrix](https://culpritsql.com/databases/): cross-engine feature comparison and evidence guarantees
- [SQL Server & Azure SQL Database](https://culpritsql.com/databases/sql-server/): Query Store, plan cache, DMVs, and Extended Events ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/mssql.md))
- [PostgreSQL & Amazon RDS](https://culpritsql.com/databases/postgresql/): `pg_stat_statements`, HypoPG virtual indexes, and `EXPLAIN` ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/postgres.md))
- [TimescaleDB](https://culpritsql.com/databases/timescaledb/): hypertables, compressed chunks, and background job diagnostics ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/timescale.md))
- [YugabyteDB](https://culpritsql.com/databases/yugabytedb/): YSQL/DocDB metrics, `DIST` plans, and `yb_pg_stat_plans` ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/yugabyte.md))
- [MySQL](https://culpritsql.com/databases/mysql/): `performance_schema`, `sys`, `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`, and slow query log ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/mysql.md))
- [MariaDB](https://culpritsql.com/databases/mariadb/): MariaDB JSON plans, `ANALYZE FORMAT=JSON`, and `userstat` ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/mariadb.md))
- [SQLite](https://culpritsql.com/databases/sqlite/): read-only file inspection, `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN`, and framework query logs ([Markdown](https://culpritsql.com/docs/providers/sqlite.md))
